content: Issue #306: feat(ruflo): 02 of 08 memory bridge — dual-path CLI and MCP integration. Branch: feat/feat-ruflo-02-of-08-memory-bridge-306. Goal: Add ruflo_store, ruflo_recall, ruflo_index_shipwright_memory, ruflo_import_memory, ruflo_export_memory to scripts/lib/ruflo-adapter.sh. Add stage artifact storage and prior context query to each pipeline stage. Add ruflo memory hint to stage prompts. All functions must be no-ops when RUFLO_AVAILABLE=false.

Implementation complete for issue #306 memory bridge. Changes: (1) ruflo-adapter.sh: added ruflo_store, ruflo_recall, ruflo_index_shipwright_memory; replaced ruflo_import_memory and ruflo_export_memory stubs with real implementations. (2) pipeline-stages-intake.sh: stage_plan and stage_design now query ruflo for prior context, inject MCP hint, and store artifacts in ruflo. (3) pipeline-stages-build.sh: stage_build and stage_test store results in ruflo. (4) pipeline-stages-review.sh: stage_review queries prior context, injects MCP hint, stores review summary. All functions are no-ops when RUFLO_AVAILABLE=false.

Issue #307: feat(ruflo): 03a of 08 - single-agent build execution via ruflo. Add ruflo_execute_build_single() to ruflo-adapter.sh. Add ruflo routing branch in stage_build() in pipeline-stages-build.sh. Falls back to sw loop when ruflo unavailable. Circuit breaker on failure. Stores build outcome in ruflo memory.

Issue #310: feat(ruflo): 05 of 08 - bridge Shipwright and ruflo learning systems. Add ruflo_learn_from_shipwright(), ruflo_recall_similar_outcomes(), ruflo_index_adr_artifacts() to ruflo-adapter.sh. Bridge skill_memory_record() in skill-memory.sh. Supplement skill_select_adaptive() in skill-select.sh. Add cross-pipeline discovery storage in sw-discovery.sh. REPO_HASH computed once at pipeline init. ALL namespaces MUST be repo-specific: learning-REPO_HASH, adrs-REPO_HASH, pipeline-discovery-REPO_HASH. Never generic namespaces.

Issue #312: feat(ruflo): 07/08 - CI runner ruflo install. Modify shipwright-pipeline.yml ONLY (no new workflow). Add: 1) Restore ruflo memory cache step, 2) Install ruflo step (continue-on-error:true) after Install Shipwright, 3) Save ruflo memory cache step. Memory functions already implemented in ruflo-adapter.sh. Tests needed for workflow YAML assertions. No separate workflow file.

Design: Modify shipwright-pipeline.yml pipeline job only. Insert after Install Shipwright: (1) Restore ruflo memory cache via actions/cache@v4 with continue-on-error:true, (2) Install ruflo via npm install -g @claude-flow/cli@latest with continue-on-error:true. Insert after Persist state step: Save ruflo memory cache with if:always() and continue-on-error:true. Cache key: ruflo-memory-${{github.repository}}-${{github.run_number}}. Path: .claude-flow/data/. Tests: grep-based YAML assertions in sw-ruflo-adapter-test.sh (Tests 36-41).

Implementation complete: Modified shipwright-pipeline.yml - added Restore ruflo memory cache (actions/cache@v4, continue-on-error:true), Install ruflo step (npm install -g @claude-flow/cli@latest, continue-on-error:true) before Pre-flight auth check. Added Save ruflo memory cache (actions/cache/save@v4, if:always(), continue-on-error:true) before Propagate pipeline exit code. Added 6 TDD tests (36-41) in sw-ruflo-adapter-test.sh. All 76 tests pass.
